name: com.cuvara.vfx
description: Agent-driven VFX Graph authoring for Unity: build a visual effect from a JSON recipe, describe and inspect any graph, import generated textures deterministically, and capture a reproducible contact sheet and stats file for review. The package is the mechanism; style and budgets live with the project that consumes it.

samples.description: A grey grid room with four effect stations (a chain-lightning lane, a single target, a ground area, an empty pedestal), rigged test characters with VFX sockets (or a placeholder mannequin when no model is present), lighting presets day, dusk and night shared with the capture stage, and a play-mode overlay to pick and replay an effect, change the time scale, the lighting and the camera preset.
